risks.risk: Wrong gearbox type/fitment (Camry year/engine variant mismatch) or incorrect pin configuration.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the gearbox identification plate/label (part number) and the transmission connector showing the pin count (22-pin) from close range.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a potentially mismatched/unknown-fit gearbox (worst case: may not bolt up or may not match wiring/connector).

risks.risk: Condition not as claimed (internal wear, noise/knock not detectable from a single static photo).
risks.proof: Short video of the gearbox being engaged/operated (or a test report/receipt) showing no abnormal noise during operation.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven working (worst case: treat as needing overhaul/repair).

risks.risk: “Never opened” claim may be false; seals/gaskets may have been replaced or internals previously serviced.
risks.proof: Photos of gasket/seal condition and any tamper marks/fastener heads; close-up of casing seams and bolts for signs of prior opening.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as previously opened/unknown history (worst case: assume overhaul risk).

risks.risk: Missing/incorrect components (e.g., sensors, solenoids, harness connectors, torque converter/related parts depending on what’s included).
risks.proof: A full inventory photo showing everything included in the sale laid out, plus a photo of the gearbox complete assembly (front/back) so missing parts are obvious.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/unknown package (worst case: buyer may need extra parts).

proof_requests: Clear close-up photos of the gearbox identification plate/label with part number and any Toyota code (must be readable).
Photo showing the transmission connector and a visible count/confirmation of 22 pins (close and sharp).
Video of the gearbox during operation/test (engagement + brief run) showing no abnormal knock.
Photos of casing seams/fasteners and gasket areas to support “never opened.”
Photos of the full gearbox unit and what exactly is included (sensors/solenoids/harness/any adapters).
response.reason: The photo does not provide readable identification or any verifiable test evidence, so the exact gearbox model/fitment and working condition cannot be confirmed remotely. To price safely, the part number/22-pin confirmation and proof of working test are needed.
